video_subject: The Visionary — Who Invented the Chicken Nugget?
video_script:
Pig: Dinner in minutes. Pure chicken genius.
Wolf: Chicken genius. Yours?
Pig: I heat 'em. I plate 'em. I'm a visionary.
Tito: Did you invent these?
Pig: I improved dinner.
Wolf: Read the smallest words.
Pig: Chicken. Water. Seasoning. Breading. Who cares?
Wolf: Who made chicken convenient?
Tito: Not him?
Wolf (V.O.): Cornell University. Robert C. Baker studies poultry.
Wolf (V.O.): Nineteen sixty-three. Baker and Joseph Marshall propose a chicken stick.
Wolf (V.O.): Ground chicken. A coating that stays put.
Wolf (V.O.): Nineteen eighty-three. McDonald's takes McNuggets nationwide.
Wolf (V.O.): Convenience has a long history.
Pig: I picked the sauce.
Wolf: A visionary.
Tito: Shh, not another word. Found the professor.
Pig: I preheated the oven.
Wolf: A visionary.
